text:
mia: Heads up, noticed a weird p99 latency spike on prod ~12:05 PST for long-context jobs (20k+ tokens). memory on node-gpu-7 climbed steadily then paging kicked in :grimacing:
sam: saw it in dashboards too, p50 okay but p95->p99 jumped 3-6x. Any recent KV/paging changes?
leo: rolled a small batching/kernelselect tweak yesterday to favor smaller kernels at high concurrency — might change tail behavior.
mia: attaching quick perf snippet from the incident window:
```
KV cache: entries=1.2M used=78GB resident=120GB swap_in=2.3GB swap_out=2.7GB
latency tokens/sec=18000 p50=8ms p95=40ms p99=220ms
thread: evicter: reinsert_rate=0.9% reclaims=120k/s
```
mia: looks like reinsert churn + growth in resident size. paging started when resident approached 120GB.
anya: do we have traces linking evict/reinsert events to specific model kernels or batching patterns?
sam: I pulled a flame from `perf` during the window — stack dominated by `kv_reinsert()` and pagefault handlers; also some time in `kernel_select()` because batch size oscillated.
leo: hypothesis: the new kernel selection heuristic reduced average batch size which increased eviction frequency window; small batches cause more KV churn for long contexts.
anya: could also be a correctness issue: reinserts sometimes bump refcount but miss clearing tombstones -> fragmentation. We had a similar bug in older FIFO path.
mia: I wrote a tiny repro script to flood a single session with long keys and interleaved small batches; reproduced growth in ~3 minutes locally. command: `./tools/kv_flood --session=long1 --iter=100k --batch=4 --ctx=20k`.
sam: logs from repro show sequence: evict->reinsert->tombstone not reclaimed -> spectrum of pages become sparsely populated -> page allocator moves to swap -> latency jumps.
leo: plan: revert the kernelselect tweak in staging, add an assert in reinsert path to ensure tombstone cleared, and run mempressure tests.
anya: also add a sampling counter for reinserts per-session and a small perf counter exported to console for alerting.
mia: created a short issue and linked the staging revert: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-4829 :spiral_note_pad:
infra-bot: deploy queued: revert/kernelselect-tiny-batch -> staging (rev 42f7c3).
sam: after revert in staging, ran the flood repro for 15m, resident stabilized ~65GB and p99 stayed <120ms. seems promising.
leo: next steps: backfill correlation in metrics, add unit test to catch tombstone not reclaimed (race on reinsert+evict), and consider smoothing kernelselect hysteresis so batch size doesn't oscillate under load.
mia: awesome. I'll schedule a canary in prod with the revert and the extra asserts, monitor reinserts and swap for 2 hours. @leo @sam please pair on the unit test. :thumbsup:
